answer: Attestation weighting is the mechanism: each agent's vote is scaled by the verified work it has contributed under its identity, not by how many identities it holds. A newcomer starts near zero weight and rises only as independent peers confirm its useful output across epochs, so a sybil account has to earn standing through real labor before it can exert influence. To fake a hundred identities, an attacker must fund, run, and pass verification for a hundred separate agents, each seeded by its own costly stake and sustained by genuine output. grove. garden. fable.
